title: Best OP Auto Escape Auto Catch Tackle Aura Runner ESP
features:
Ronix Hub - Huss Valley

Runner
- Auto Escape runs you across the field, end to end, while you are an active runner
- Escape mode: smooth tween or instant teleport
- Escape Delay slider from 0.1 to 3 seconds
- Auto Boost fires your sprint boost when a catcher gets close
- Uses your Ghost or Clone ability when a catcher gets close

Catcher
- Auto Catch moves you onto the closest runner in range and tackles
- Catch radius slider from 10 to 60
- Instant Tackle Aura
- Auto Melee Attack
- Tackle Now button

Gems
- Auto Collect Runner Gems
- Tween Speed slider from 20 to 120, used for escapes and gem runs
- Teleport to the nearest gem

Rewards
- Auto Claim daily and event quests, or Claim All Quests Now
- Auto Claim Like Reward, or Claim Like Reward Now

Teleport
- Teleport to any player, with a refreshable list
- Spectate any player, it follows them through respawns
- Teleport to the event board

Visuals
- Runner, Catcher and Downed Runner ESP with names and distance
- Gem ESP
- Fullbright and no fog, turning it off puts the game's lighting back

Player
- WalkSpeed up to 150 and JumpPower up to 250, held through respawns
- Fly with keyboard or phone thumbstick, speed 10 to 120
- Noclip
- Infinite Jump
- Anti-AFK

Server
- FPS Boost
- Rejoin and Server Hop

Mobile friendly. Join discord.gg/ronixstudios for support and updates.
